variants.name: 柔宋花笺 · 清疏目录
variants.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup edit.
Input roles: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a typography preview. Image 2 is the CLEAN original background reference. Images 3, 4, 5 are Cecilia's calm, shy and smiling character references only.
User revision: remove the framed tiles and create real breathing room. The upper title '指令手册' is liked. Change ONLY the menu area and footer layout. Preserve the target's title style, upper-right portrait, outer botanical stationery border and harmonious palette. Preserve character identity.
Replace the boxed grid with ONE airy borderless vertical directory, eight simple rows from y=540 to y=1250. Each row has a modest artistic category label at x=200 and a smaller readable command at x=490, aligned on the same baseline. Category lettering about 48px; command lettering about 29px. Row stride about 85px, ample untouched ivory space between rows. No line separators. This should resemble a quietly designed book contents page. Retain the original soft literary serif style, reduce category size dramatically from the input.
Exact content in order: '模型' with '/help 模型'; '角色' with '/help 角色'; '回复' with '/help 回复'; '群聊' with '/help 群聊'; '养成' with '/help 养成'; '材料' with '/help 材料'; '权限' with '/help 权限'; '插件' with '/help 插件'.
Footer at y approximately 1360: '群聊先 @ 目标 Bot' and '文字版 /help 文字', small understated readable text, no surrounding shape.
Critical constraints: NO card boxes, NO rectangles, NO rounded containers, NO per-entry borders, NO filled background panels, NO line separators, NO repeated floral decorations around each category, NO huge category labels filling the page. Text directly on the original light ivory paper. Keep at least half the menu area visually empty. Restore clean ivory wherever old tiles and their decorative clutter were. Typography subtly artistic but upright, separate glyphs, not cursive; match the girl and stationery. Accurate simplified Chinese, exact given text only, no extra prose, no style labels. Portrait 1024x1536.
